title: Philippines PCSO Historical Draw Results
subtitle: A 13,457-row historical results snapshot with draw dates, Philippine-time sessions, winning numbers, and row-level source URLs.
description: An independently compiled historical snapshot for nine Philippine digit and jackpot games: 2D, 3D, 4D, 6D, Lotto 6/42, Mega Lotto 6/45, Super Lotto 6/49, Grand Lotto 6/55, and Ultra Lotto 6/58. Coverage runs from 2022-01-02 through 2026-07-20, with game-specific date ranges. Each result row retains its public source name and URL. The package also includes normal draw schedules, field definitions, Frictionless Data metadata, citation metadata, and methodology notes. This is not an official PCSO database and is provided for information and research rather than prediction. Official PCSO channels remain the final authority.
